title: Eval corpus run record
description: Documented shape of an eval/corpus/runs/<run-id>.json file, written by D365FO.Core.Eval.EvalCorpusStore.Append. One file per (case_id, run_id). Committed — the corpus is the evidence the eval-improver ranks failure clusters from, so it has to survive across machines and CI runs.

source.description: replay = `d365fo eval run` (deterministic, canonical_args). agent = `d365fo eval score` fed by the eval-runner agent driving the natural-language instruction by hand. build-oracle = `d365fo eval verify-build`, which scores only the build dimension and leaves the offline ones null rather than copying them from an earlier run.

buildClean.description: L3 only: xppc compiled this case's golden with zero errors. null means no compiler ran — never false by default, because reporting a compile verdict nobody collected is the confident lie the triage rubric puts first.

classification.description: A hypothesis recorded by the runner, confirmed or corrected by the eval-improver before any fix lands. Replay and build-oracle runs derive it from the scorecard (no model is in the loop, so MODEL_ERROR is impossible); agent runs leave it null unless --hypothesis is passed, because there the same scorecard is equally consistent with a tool defect and with the agent's own mistake. See docs/AGENT_EVAL_LOOP.md §9.
